description: Search the catalogue. Returns product cards: slug, name, kind (asset or pack), shelf, blurb, url, prices per licence tier in US cents, tags (style, topic, format), and `owned` (the person's tier if they already own it). Page with nextCursor.

format.description: A format tag, e.g. pdf, wav, glb, png.

kind.description: asset: one product; pack: a bundle of several.

maxCents.description: Only products from at most this price, in US cents (2000 = $20).

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'weekly planner a5' or 'retro ui sound effects'.

style.description: A style tag, e.g. minimal, pixel-art.

name: search_products
title: Search the store
